description:
[Broker Sync API] Register a user with SnapTrade and get a brokerage connection-portal URL.

Use when you are onboarding a user and need a SnapTrade brokerage connection-portal URL. Not for reading data for an already connected user.

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

user_id.description: Your application's stable identifier for this end user.

name: broker_sync_register_user
